description: Na₂Li₃CoO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with ten LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.53 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four LiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-46°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.03 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.08 Å. Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with six LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with three LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.93 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three Na, three Li, and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three Na, three Li, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three Na, three Li, and one Co atom.
